publication: Exact tested commit may be published after parent confirms independent review; parent handles PR/merge

limits: Virtual and real share the C# emitter/runtime
C# raw snapshot faults propagate; Python records failed snapshot
Only admitted close publishes intent; bare owner cancellation without close remains separate
Checks already entered finish; no atomic cross-task check-start cutoff is claimed
Queued mutation protection remains separate; queued callers cancel independently

replay: Saved/reopened, same-path and copied-path graph/source/symbol/case identities preserved

environment.expandedLocalExecution: SDK writes, child-process waits and test sockets; no automatic approval review denial
